dogecoin.text:
@dogecoin_empire We're simply not interested.  That's not the same thing. Projecting your fear onto men is a lie.

Men want to be happy.  Your incessant competition and ranting is not happiness, its insanity.  Go live with your girlfriend - she also doesn't care.

@dogecoin_empire What men really want is someone who is openly loving, loyal and honest. We don't want drama, we don't care about the bullshit.  We want peace.  We want security in the knowledge that what is ours is ours.
Your pics are meaningless without a sense of normality and reality.
